seo.title: NOIR — Bespoke Tailoring, Atlanta · By Appointment Only
seo.description: NOIR is a by-appointment bespoke tailoring atelier in Atlanta. A suit that exists for one man only — commissioned, not bought. Request a private appointment.

hero.imageAlt: The NOIR atelier at night — fitting mirror, leather chair and a wall of suiting cloth in warm light
hero.title:
A suit that exists
for *one man* only.
hero.sub: Bespoke tailoring for those who command distinction — cut by hand, to your measure alone. One client at a time, by appointment only.

invitation.imageAlt: Macro of cloth on the tailor's bench
invitation.figtag: On the tailor's bench · cloth from heritage mills
invitation.lead: At NOIR, bespoke suiting is an uncompromising art — an intimate journey into a personal style, realised through the hands of master tailors.
invitation.body: Each suit is a personal hallmark of quality and sophistication, cut to a single body and a single life. In a world of abundance, we make one thing exceptionally well: the suit that is unmistakably yours — delivered with the utmost discretion through our concierge service.

acts.imageAlt: A private consultation table with fabric books and whisky
acts.title: The Consultation
acts.desc: A private conversation over coffee or whisky — style, occasion, and the story the suit must tell.

acts.imageAlt: A muslin toile pinned on a tailor's form
acts.title: The Fittings
acts.desc: Thirty measurements, a muslin, then refinements — until the cloth learns the way you move.

acts.imageAlt: A finished charcoal suit on a wooden hanger
acts.title: The Reveal
acts.desc: The final fitting — and, should the occasion ask, a concierge who tends to the day itself.

atelierBand.heading:
A room kept for
one guest at a time.
atelierBand.body: Behind a discreet door in Atlanta, the atelier receives a single client at a time. There is no rail to browse, no queue — only your tailor, a wall of cloth from English and Italian mills, and an espresso or a whisky poured on arrival. The address is part of the luxury; the privacy, entirely the point.
atelierBand.imageAlt: An antique three-panel fitting mirror in the dark atelier

distinction.imageAlt: A chief executive in a bespoke navy double-breasted suit
distinction.figtag: The double-breasted navy · for the office
distinction.eyebrow: For Those Who Command a Room
distinction.heading:
The wardrobe of
a serious man.
distinction.body: Bespoke is the everyday discipline of the C-suite and the founder — the navy that carries a negotiation, the charcoal that closes it, the grey three-piece that needs no introduction. We build a considered wardrobe around your calendar and keep your measure on file, so the next commission begins where the last one ended.
bullets: Business & travel suiting, built for the way you work
A personal body profile, kept for every future order
